consent.title: Before we keep your movement results
consent.body: To compare how far your joints move with what is usual for your sex and age, to show you how your movement changes over time and to build your program from it, we need to keep your results in your account.
consent.pointKept: We keep numbers only: the degrees each joint we measure moves, your walking numbers if you walk, and one step of your walk as skeleton lines with no picture.
consent.pointProfile: We read them with your sex, your age and the areas you marked on the body map in Your medical condition.
consent.pointVideo: We never record or send the video: it is processed on your phone only.
consent.pointWhere: Your results are kept on servers of the company Railway in the Netherlands, outside the Kingdom.
consent.pointWithdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time from Your medical condition. Your earlier results stay until you ask us to delete them.
consent.privacyLink: Read how we use your data
consent.agree: I agree that my movement and walking results are kept in my account, so I can see how my movement changes and my program is built from them.

rf_region_ask: Today, in your {region}: is it hot, red or swollen, has its shape changed, or is there new numbness or weakness? Or do you have a fever?
rf_region_ask_leg: Today, in your {region}: is it hot, red or swollen, has its shape changed, is there new numbness or weakness, or have you been unable to stand on that leg since an injury? Or do you have a fever?

shell.name: Focused movement check
shell.loadError: We could not open the check. Make sure you are online, then try again.
shell.saveError: Your results are not saved yet. Make sure you are online, then try again.
shell.startError: The check did not start. Your answers are still here, so you can try again.
shell.leaveBody: What we have measured so far is kept.

closed.intakeTitle: We need your body map first
closed.intakeBody: Mark the areas your medical condition affects on the body map, then come back to the check.
closed.homeTitle: This check runs at the booth for now
closed.homeBody: For now, the focused movement check runs on our team's phone at the booth.
closed.planBody: We build the check from your answers about your medical condition.
closed.reviewBody: We will open the check once your plan is reviewed.
closed.rateBody: You started the check many times today. You can try again tomorrow.
closed.nothingTitle: There is nothing to measure today
closed.nothingBody: For your safety, we will not measure today. You can try another day.

intro.title: Your focused movement check
intro.walk: Then we look at your walk

block.camera: Put the phone on a steady stand and make sure you can see yourself in the picture.
block.helperReady: My helper is beside me. Ready

measure.start: Take the start position and hold still
measure.move: Move slowly as far as you can without pain
measure.band: Typical for your age and sex

result.quality: The camera could not see the movement clearly enough, so we did not record it today.
result.byChoice: You stopped this movement, so we did not record it today.

sit.title: Before you stand

gait.title: Your walk
gait.body: Next we look at how you walk.
